irregularities.value: Demo market objects return status "active" even when fetched with status=open; docs' canonical market status set is unopened / open / closed / settled. This site treats "active" as open and flags the mismatch.

irregularities.item: Placeholder settlement sources in demo metadata
irregularities.value: Some demo series (e.g. KXXBANNEDGROK, Culture) list settlement sources with template artifacts such as 'https://www.google.com/search?q=account holder of' and bare 'https://kalshi.com/'. These are demo data-quality issues; such URLs are shown only as-is and flagged, never treated as authoritative.

irregularities.item: KXGAS has zero events on demo
irregularities.value: GET /events?series_ticker=KXGAS (any status) returns an empty array — the 'Gas weekly' series exists but the demo environment lists no events for it at snapshot time. The gas tab may therefore be legitimately empty until the demo seeds events.
Open KXBTCD hourly markets at snapshot show volume 0.00 and 0/1 quotes on the first page — the ranking and bot will correctly show little activity until demo participants trade.

irregularities.item: WebSocket cannot be used from a static page
irregularities.value: Kalshi's WebSocket requires KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY/SIGNATURE/TIMESTAMP headers during the handshake; browsers cannot set custom headers on WebSocket handshakes without credentials. This site therefore uses REST polling (documented 'separate limits' for unauthenticated requests) instead of WS.

irregularities.item: Browser CORS behavior not verifiable from the build environment
irregularities.value: The build sandbox only permits github/npm/pypi egress, so a browser-to-Kalshi CORS check could not be executed during the build. The site degrades to the verified snapshot with a clear banner if the browser is blocked, and the manual verification command is printed in the banner and README.

irregularities.item: 'Highest dollar amount' ranking is an estimate
irregularities.value: The API publishes volume in contracts, not official per-event dollar volume. Ranking uses est. traded $ = Σ(volume × last price) and est. OI $ = Σ(open interest × mid), clearly labeled as estimates on every screen. True traded dollars are computed from official trade prints only for the selected market's tape sample.

Used as the exchange-reported 'price before the latest trade' for a second, independent swing signal. The field name comes from the official Get Markets schema; its exact description was not visible in the fetched doc chunk, so this semantic is flagged as an assumption.

Empty candlesticks arrays occur for markets with no trades in the window (observed live) and recent candles can lag trades by a few seconds (documented). Seconds-resolution views are built from page-side samples; 1-hour/6-hour/24-hour windows use official 1-minute candles when available.

irregularities.item: Unauthenticated rate limit values are not published numerically
irregularities.value: Docs state unauthenticated requests have separate limits and to back off on 429, without numbers. This site therefore serializes requests with a 350 ms minimum gap, exponential backoff on 429 (up to 30 s), and shows throttle counters.

Fee formula verified from the official schedule 'Last updated and effective: July 7, 2026'. Fee multipliers per series are read live from the /series endpoint (demo series checked are fee_multiplier 1, fee_type quadratic).

irregularities.item: Golf events not individually isolated at snapshot
irregularities.value: Golf series are verified (via /series?tags=Golf), but whether any golf EVENT is currently open on demo was not isolated into a verified count at snapshot time (the broad open-events listing was not fully paged during the build). The live golf tab computes this at view time from official data.
